the origin and evolution of a new isolate of FMDV serotype Asia 01, which has been identified in Mongolia, and which is related to strains isolated in China in 2005.
the molecular epidemiology of serotype Asia1 and the evolution of FMDV in Mongolia.
the genetic diversity and recombination events of serotype Asia1 FMDV in Mongolia and China.
